source.title: Unifying Generic Group Models
locations_opened: Theorem 3, page 16 and proof completion on page 17

section_5_1.game_state: The game samples (p,x) from D before preprocessing, but x is not placed in a register or exposed to S.pre.
section_5_1.preprocessing: S.pre may make k.pre operations and function queries; in Theorem 3 and Corollary 3 k.pre is infinity.
section_5_1.phase_boundary: All game registers are cleared before the main phase; the game then writes x into V1.
section_5_1.cross_phase_channel: S.pre sends S.main one advice string z.
section_5_1.solver_class: pS_ell consists of solvers split into independent preprocessing and main phases that pass an ell-bit advice string.
section_5_1.main_phase: The game answers at most k.main interactions and then receives the solver's guess x'.

theorem_3.integer_conditions: k and ell are positive integers
theorem_3.quantifier: for every solver S in pS_ell
theorem_3.game: average-case extraction with uniform (pi,x) in P_N x Z_N

corollary_3.ro_definition: On registered v, ro returns RO(pi(v)) for one random function RO: Z_N -> Z_N available in both phases.
corollary_3.quantifier: for every solver S in pS_ell
corollary_3.game: average-case extraction with uniform pi, x, and the random function used by ro
corollary_3.proof_binding: Appendix F.6 fixes each random function h, simulates ro with dense plus internal h, applies Theorem 3, and averages over uniform h without changing the number of queries.

N.source_type: prime group order and size of Z_N

pi.source_type: uniform permutation in P_N that defines the dense representation
pi.binding: requires a generic-representation success guarantee, not a fixed coordinate representation

x.source_type: uniform element of Z_N hidden during preprocessing and inserted as V1 after clearing
x.binding: exact under the additive representation Z_N

ell.source_type: number of bits in the sole advice string z
ell.binding: ell <= O(W log N) for W ordinary O(log N)-bit words; words and opaque handles are not themselves ell

k.source_type: hard total main-phase count of computation operations and function queries
k.packet_value: aggregate target construction, all adaptive calls, all reconstruction, dense and ro queries, and verification
k.binding: exact only for one aggregate hard cap; not per call, expected, or amortized

k_pre.binding: Theorem 3 and Corollary 3 set it to infinity

m_registers.binding: no register or opaque group handle crosses the phase boundary

ro.source_type: shared random function queried only through RO(pi(v)) on registered group values
ro.binding: valid only for this exact interface or a separately proved reduction to it

average_case_quantifiers.distribution: uniform over P_N x Z_N, and additionally over RO in Corollary 3
probability_includes: shared random function when ro is present
does_not_state: a pointwise bound for every fixed pi
a bound for an oracle different from dense and the source's ro
average_case_quantifiers.sufficient_packet_guarantee: A positive constant success probability for the complete special-deck session under uniform fresh x and generic representation, or a stronger for-all-pi-and-x guarantee.
average_case_quantifiers.insufficient_packet_guarantee: Success only for one fixed representation or only marginal per-query correctness.

public_before_target: all occurrence labels and scalar coefficients of the special decks
must_be_in_advice_bits: stored dense representations and ro outputs
private randomness needed by both phases
known scalar lineage or other reconstruction metadata
preprocessing_and_handle_binding.main_reconstruction: Any cleared handle used online must be reconstructed with operations and queries charged to k. The word cap alone does not imply this reconstruction fits k; the packet's separate aggregate-interaction premise is necessary.
preprocessing_and_handle_binding.verdict: matches A3-A8 when those assumptions are read literally

interaction_accounting.interaction_unit: one computation operation (+ or 1) or one function query (dense or ro)
internal_free_work: serialization parsing after receipt of z
forming the integer candidate x' before group verification

charged_main_terms.deck_reconstruction: At most O(10*m*log N)=B^(1+o(1)) by conservative independent binary scalar multiplication of every signed occurrence.
charged_main_terms.preprocessed_handle_reconstruction: K_lineage, with every operation or query included; no bound follows from W alone.
charged_main_terms.target_formation: O(log N) operations to construct [C]P and one addition with V1=x.
charged_main_terms.adaptive_predicate_calls: q=5*ceil(log2(2m)) calls; sum all internal +, 1, dense, and ro interactions over the complete transcript.
charged_main_terms.returned_handle_reconstruction: Charge every reconstruction; singleton labels may make handles unnecessary, but they are never free if used.
charged_main_terms.decoding: Scalar decoding is internal; any group operation or representation query used during decoding is charged.
charged_main_terms.verification: O(log N) additions to build [x']P plus the dense queries or other simulated comparison needed to check Q.
charged_main_terms.abort_and_output: The extraction game's final equality test is outside k, but any solver-side verification before output is inside k.

interaction_accounting.aggregate_formula: k = K_decks + K_lineage + K_target + sum_j K_query_j + K_return + K_decode_group + K_verify
interaction_accounting.required_cap: the formula above is at most B^(5/4+o(1)) on every main-phase execution, not merely in expectation
interaction_accounting.verdict: holds under A6-A8; breaks if any term is omitted or if k is refreshed per call

transcript_success.sufficient: One session-level event of probability c>0 on which every adaptive answer needed for isolation is exact.
transcript_success.insufficient: For each query separately, an unconditional marginal probability at least c; correlations and adaptive conditioning can make all-correct probability zero.
transcript_success.possible_amplification: If every adaptively selected restriction has a uniform conditional error below 1/2 and fresh reruns are available, majority amplification can make total error constant with polylogarithmic overhead, but the repetitions and oracle queries must be charged to k.
transcript_success.packet_binding: A12 expressly requires transcript-level composition, so the frozen conditional theorem has the sufficient form.
transcript_success.verdict: holds with A12; breaks without it

exponent_recomputation.constant_success_contradiction: For any fixed c>0, the MPZ upper bound is below c for all sufficiently large N, contradicting the assumed complete-transcript success at least c.

source_proof_note.observation: The displayed proof of Theorem 3 chooses p=(ell+log N)k and then states the final 3*ell*(k+1)^2/N simplification.
source_proof_note.relevance: The packet can pad its advice parameter to the declared ell cap N^(9/20+o(1)), which dominates log N. Even retaining ell+log N explicitly produces the same N^(-1/20+o(1)) exponent.
source_proof_note.joint_effect: no change to the frozen asymptotic rectangle

model_stops: per-query marginal success without transcript control
expected or per-call interaction cap instead of one hard aggregate cap
shared oracle not covered by Definition 12 or a proved reduction
